[1/2] Graphics cycle: deterministic 64x64 wall-panel texture on material.wall, capture route and before/after pair, inspect for stretching

impact_assessment.why: Boundary walls are flat gray boxes; cover panels got seams in cycle 49 but walls still read as untextured slabs, weakening the arena enclosure at spawn and long sightlines.
impact_assessment.benefits: A material-only panel texture adds seams/bands to all four walls with no new nodes, draw calls or colliders, and keeps determinism.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: material/texture only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no sim, save or physics change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first texture tests, a seeded wall_texture capture pair at 960x540, and a same-hash played run; keep checker_scale gentle to avoid world-block banding.
